scope: All six stellar catalog layers plus the shared companion pool; reviewed definitions and UI fallback name groups. Frozen ORB6 2026-10-09 and MSC 2026-06-19, not an exhaustive literature search.
findings: 14 previously name-only systems were absent from the reviewed import. Their membership is frozen in census system IDs or corrected CNS5 component records; WDS identity comes from the existing designation registry.
Epsilon Indi Ba/Bb had separate census and MSC-generated identities. Preserve census IDs 10pc-0042/0043 and retain MSC IDs as aliases; no new astronomical components.
Compound ORB6 pair AB,C was parsed as B,C, dropping a group member. Accept complete uppercase groups on either side, then require every group member.
Nested Aa and Aab nodes were rejected although their individual children were explicitly cataloged. Resolve those complete child groups without inferring membership.
Implicit ORB6 pairs can be recovered only with an exact WDS/reference/designation/period cross-reference in frozen MSC orb.tsv; 0.5 percent maximum period tolerance accounts for compiled rounding.
ORB6 Julian-year epoch flag j was previously unrecognized; preserve it explicitly.

scopeEvidence.detail: Ddr2025 GKI 1AB 76-year solution is GJ 105 AC. Frozen CNS5/SIMBAD labels B refer to the wider BX Cet, WDS C.
Close visual orbit is Gliese 22 AC; frozen WDS names it Aa/Ab. VYS 2AB is the wide orbit.
Published Gl 570 BC double-lined pair corresponds to WDS Ba/Bb. MSC hierarchy explicitly puts that pair in B.
Section 5.8 resolves GJ 1245 AC; census system 43 establishes the third component B.
sys.tsv 17190-3459: AB|C, HJ_4935 AC; explicit app A/B/C membership from ESO and CNS5.
sys.tsv 00084+2905 A|B explicitly identifies MKT_11 Aa,Ab; flat reviewed app stars are the same spectroscopic pair.
sys.tsv 02449+1007 A|B identifies TOK_1 Aa,Ab; do not resolve the speculative B subsystems.
Reviewed K3III+F0V pair for exact HIP 112158; WDS BLA 11Aa,Ab is the 817.41-day stellar pair.
sys.tsv distinguishes CSI_1Aa1,2 SB9_157 2.865-day inner pair from LAB_2Aa,Ab SB9_158 1.862-year outer orbit.
sys.tsv explicitly labels MCA_16 Aa,Ab as Aab|Ac; SB9_266 Aa|Ab is the distinct 2.956-day pair.
sys.tsv associates SB9_340 65.432 days with Aa1|Aa2. The Aa|Ab visual pair has a roughly 200-year estimated period; do not attach the spectroscopic orbit to it.

retainedUnavailableExamples.reason: BEU 22Ba,Bb is GJ 852 BC; reviewed catalog only has outer A and unresolved B. The source orbit must not be attached to A-B.
TSN 195Aa,Ab describes an unresolved inner pair in A; catalog B is the outer LP 756-18.
Old 68-year, 1.5-arcsecond photocenter solution is not safely identified with the resolved 18.5-mas close companion from the reviewed Jodar source; do not relabel it automatically.
902.9-day gam CepAa,Ab solution is a planet; keep only the separately scoped NHR 9AB stellar orbit.
WDS Aa/Ab is Theta2 Tau, a different physical pair from cataloged Theta1 Tau Ba/Bb; keep the 16.26-year Ba/Bb orbit.
Two Trapezium subsystems share a WDS cross-reference. Reject ambiguous identity matches; retain source-specific MSC orbits.
No safely matched solved orbit in the frozen inputs; this does not imply no published orbit exists.
